SubTopics: Use a model to describe the process of natural selection, in which genetic variations of some traits in a population increase some individuals' likelihood of surviving and reproducing in a changing environment. Provide evidence that natural selection occurs over many generations.
Content: :ibox:THIS QUESTION HAS `bbtext(TWO)` PARTS.

Snowshoe hares change fur color depending on the season. In `text(winter)`, their fur is mostly white, while in `text(spring)andtext(summer)` their fur is mostly brown. The pictures show how the snowshoe hare blends into its environment in `text(winter)` and in `text(summer)`.
problems/MA25G8S/media/8a.jpg
problems/MA25G8S/media/8b.jpg
Explain how blending into its environment most likely helps the snowshoe hare survive.

The timing of a snowshoe hare's color change is influenced by genetics. Some individual snowshoe hares change their fur color from white to brown earlier in the `text(spring)` than other snowshoe hares. Because of climate change, the areas where snowshoe hares live are expected to have fewer `text(days)` with snow on the ground in the `text(spring)`.
